brands.name: j.kashiwai Surfboards
brands.short_description: Hawaii shaper Jason Kashiwai develops high quality boards with the best craftsmanship. High-performance shapes tested all over the world by his team riders.

models.name: Coffee Break
models.description: A fish-style board great for small groveler days. Not a bulky old-school fish, but a more modern performer. Comes with a stealth swallow tail with a single to double concave vee out the tail. Fin Setup: Tri-Quad, 5-FIN. Tail Style: Swallow. Sizes: 5'4 - 6'2.

models.name: Buck Short
models.description: This is a step down meant to be ridden 2-4 inches shorter than your everyday board. Great for small days, but also a good everyday performer. Features fuller rails and a little fuller foil to keep the volume up. Comes with a single concave and squash tail. Fin Setup: Thruster. Tail Style: Squash. Sizes: 5'6 - 6'0.

models.name: Buzz Saw
models.description: Your everyday shortboard! Features a lower rocker, and single to double concave with vee off the tail. Fin Setup: Thruster. Tail Style: Squash or RP. Sizes: 5'9 - 6'1.

models.name: Krank
models.description: A high performance team favorite! Features a high rocker for in-the-pocket surfing and a single concave. Fin Setup: Thruster. Tail Style: Squash. Sizes: 5'9 - 6'2.

models.name: Evil Twin
models.description: Old school twin keel featuring a flat deck wing swallow or straight swallow.

models.name: Mid Length
models.description: Twin or 2+1 fin set up when wave count or fun factor is important.

models.name: DEVO twin
models.description: Performance twin keel more of a thruster feel very positive good for aggressive performance surfing.

models.name: Phoenix Quad
models.description: Performance 4-fin or 5-fin swallow tail with single concave, featuring a medium-high rocker and a lower apex rail. This design creates a very fast, fluid, and highly sensitive board that responds effortlessly. It can easily become your reliable everyday driver in a variety of conditions.

models.name: Da Kine
models.description: Da Kine your Uncle rides at Waikiki with that classic 50/50 style rail, a pronounced nose concave, and a wide tail block for stability. Just cruising through life, taking it easy and enjoying the ride.
